import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;

    static class ModInt {
        final int val;

        private ModInt(int v) {
            val = v;
        }

        static final ModInt ZERO = new ModInt(0);
        static final ModInt ONE = new ModInt(1);

        static ModInt of(int v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            return new ModInt(v);
        }

        static ModInt of(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            return new ModInt((int) v);
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            int newVal = val + other.val;
            if (newVal >= MOD) newVal -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(newVal);
        }

        ModInt subtract(ModInt other) {
            int newVal = val - other.val;
            if (newVal < 0) newVal += MOD;
            return new ModInt(newVal);
        }

        ModInt multiply(ModInt other) {
            long prod = (long) val * other.val;
            return new ModInt((int) (prod % MOD));
        }

        ModInt divide(ModInt other) {
            return this.multiply(other.inv());
        }

        ModInt pow(long e) {
            ModInt result = ONE;
            ModInt base = this;
            while (e > 0) {
                if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                    result = result.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            // extended Euclidean algorithm
            int a = val;
            int b = MOD;
            int ax = 1, bx = 0;
            while (b != 0) {
                int q = a / b;
                int t = a % b;
                a = b;
                b = t;
                t = ax - bx * q;
                ax = bx;
                bx = t;
            }
            if (ax < 0) ax += MOD;
            return new ModInt(ax);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(val);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int number = sc.nextInt();
        List<ModInt> probability = new ArrayList<>(number * number);
        for (int i = 0; i < number * number; ++i) {
            int percentage = sc.nextInt();
            // probability = modular(1)/100 * percentage = percentage/100
            probability.add(ModInt.of(percentage).divide(ModInt.of(100)));
        }

        int middle = number / 2;
        int size = 1 << number;
        int[] maskValue = new int[size];
        int count = 0;
        for (int matchMask = 0; matchMask < size; ++matchMask) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(matchMask) == middle) {
                maskValue[matchMask] = count++;
            } else {
                maskValue[matchMask] = -1;
            }
        }

        int totalSize = 1 << count;
        List<ModInt> total = new ArrayList<>(totalSize);
        for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; ++i) total.add(ModInt.ZERO);

        // process left half: [0, middle)
        process(0, middle, number, middle, probability, maskValue, (sets, prob) -> {
            total.set(sets, total.get(sets).add(prob));
        });

        // SOS DP over total
        for (int dim = 1; dim < totalSize; dim <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; ++i) {
                if ((i & dim) == 0) {
                    total.set(i | dim, total.get(i | dim).add(total.get(i)));
                }
            }
        }

        ModInt result = ModInt.ZERO;
        // process right half: [middle, number)
        process(middle, number, number, middle, probability, maskValue, (sets, prob) -> {
            result = result.add(prob.multiply(total.get(totalSize - 1).subtract(total.get(totalSize - 1 - sets))));
        });

        System.out.println(result.val);
    }

    static void process(int left, int right, int number, int middle,
                        List<ModInt> probability, int[] maskValue,
                        BiConsumer<Integer, ModInt> handler) {
        int len = right - left;
        int edgeMaskLimit = 1 << (len * number);
        for (int edgeMask = 0; edgeMask < edgeMaskLimit; ++edgeMask) {
            ModInt totalProb = ModInt.ONE;
            boolean zeroFlag = false;
            for (int i = left * number, tmp = edgeMask; i < right * number; ++i, tmp >>= 1) {
                if ((tmp & 1) != 0) {
                    totalProb = totalProb.multiply(probability.get(i));
                } else {
                    totalProb = totalProb.multiply(ModInt.ONE.subtract(probability.get(i)));
                }
                if (totalProb.val == 0) {
                    zeroFlag = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (zeroFlag) continue;

            int[] data = new int[len];
            int matchSets = 0;
            while (true) {
                // check validity of current data
                boolean valid = true;
                int matchMask = 0;
                for (int index = 0; index < len; ++index) {
                    int pos = index * number + data[index];
                    if ((edgeMask >> pos & 1) == 0) {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    int bit = 1 << data[index];
                    if ((matchMask & bit) != 0) {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    matchMask |= bit;
                }
                if (valid) {
                    if (right == number) { // second half, invert
                        matchMask ^= (1 << number) - 1;
                    }
                    int setIdx = maskValue[matchMask];
                    if (setIdx >= 0) {
                        matchSets |= 1 << setIdx;
                    }
                }

                // increment data array (like counting in base number)
                int i = len - 1;
                while (i >= 0 && data[i] == number - 1) {
                    data[i] = 0;
                    i--;
                }
                if (i < 0) break;
                data[i]++;
            }

            handler.accept(matchSets, totalProb);
        }
    }
}
